description: This file is a Lua script focused on testing and verifying the behavior of Lua's generational garbage collection. It includes assertions, manipulations of garbage collector states, and tests for specific garbage collection scenarios and bugs.

methods.name: gcage
methods.description: Used for checking the age category ('new', 'survival', 'old', etc.) of objects as part of the garbage collection tests.

methods.name: gccolor
methods.description: Used for checking the color ('gray', 'black', etc.) of objects in the garbage collector's cycle during tests.
